user.title: Connect your Scandia fireplace
user.description: Enter the local connection details for your fireplace. You need the device's IP address, its Tuya Device ID and Local Key. See the integration README for how to obtain the Local Key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the fireplace. Check the IP address, Device ID, Local Key and protocol version, and make sure Home Assistant is on the same network.

init.title: Scandia fireplace data points
init.description: Map the Tuya data point (DP) IDs to fireplace functions. Leave an optional field blank to disable that feature. Download the integration's diagnostics to see the raw DP IDs your device reports.
